title: Permissions: Declare Them and Check Them in Your Module | Orchard Core
description:
A module that offers an action to some users and not to others needs its own permissions: a name for each right, a way for roles to hold it, and a check in the code that enforces it.

This video declares a permission with a name and a description, lists it in an IPermissionProvider, shows how the roles editor displays permissions, and checks it with IAuthorizationService in a controller, a view and a menu.

In this video:
• What a permission is, and how roles and users hold it
• Declaring a permission: name, description, translation, security critical, implied by, category
• Providing permissions with IPermissionProvider, default roles, registration and recipes
• How the roles editor displays permissions
• Checking a permission in a controller, a view and a menu item
